_classes.name: Resolvable actor stored with agency 'Unspecified' (borough president, State enforcement officials, city school district, Battery Park City, other state agencies)
_classes.rule: agency == 'Unspecified' and re.search(r'borough president|of this state|state (officer|official|agenc)|\bmayor\b|county|city|town|village|school district|commissioner of|department of', actor_raw, re.I)

_classes.name: Effective date unparsed for 'N years after the date on which it shall have become a law' (variant of the class listed as fixed; 2013 effective_dates rebuilt Oct 12 still null)
_classes.rule: effective_dates[law].effective_date is None and re.search(r'take effect (on the )?\S+ (\(\d+\) )?(years?|months?|days?) after (the date on which it|it) shall have become a law', raw_clause, re.I); count records whose matter_id is such a law
_classes.note: Same rule matches 56 laws in effective_dates/*.json (55 in 2017-2025 files last built Oct 8, none with stored records yet); all 105 null-effective records DB-wide: 2009 unparsed 39, 2011 unparsed 12, 2013 unparsed 31, 2013 same_as_chapter_unresolved 19, 2015 unparsed 4

_classes.name: extends_existing false where new matter changes how an existing duty is performed (new service method inserted into an existing 'shall be served' sentence)
_classes.rule: none mechanical: needs the braced/unbraced split of the source sentence

_classes.name: Missed duties/powers carried by implied or passive phrasing ('in a format prescribed by the superintendent', 'regulations established by the commission', licensing administered by 'the department', 'may be accepted by the department', 'admission to the examination may be given', 'will be based upon')
_classes.rule: none over stored records (misses); a packet-text scan for r'(prescribed|established|issued|approved|determined) by the (superintendent|commission|department|commissioner|board)|may be (accepted|given|issued) by' in braced matter would surface candidates
